candidates.change_summary: Return a different hardcoded selector instead of this contract's onERC721Received selector.
Return bytes4(0) instead of the onERC721Received selector.
Delete the statement `baseToken = _baseToken;` so baseToken remains address(0) after initialize.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken stores the NFT address instead.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = address(0);` so baseToken is always set to the zero address.
Insert `baseToken = address(0);` just before `initialized = true;` so it overwrites the earlier assignment, leaving baseToken as address(0) after initialize completes.
Assign _baseToken to nft instead of _nft, so the stored nft address is wrong.
Set nft to the zero address instead of _nft.
Delete the assignment `nft = _nft;`, leaving nft at its default zero address after initialization.
Delete the statement that assigns _changeFee to changeFee, leaving changeFee at its default value of 0 after initialize.
Replace the assignment changeFee = _changeFee with changeFee = uint56(_feeRate), so changeFee receives the fee rate instead of the passed change fee.
